from semver import VersionInfo, _LAST_NUMBER, _increment_string

v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, build='build1')
print('Original:', v.build)
result = _increment_string(v.build)
print('After _increment_string:', result)

# Check what my code does
match = _LAST_NUMBER.search(v.build)
if match:
    print('Has numeric suffix')
    new_build = _increment_string(v.build)
else:
    new_build = v.build + '.1'
print('New build:', new_build)
"
